name: I2-CG droid
description: I2-CG droids were a model of droid. The plating on their barrel-shaped bodies was white, while their domed heads had silver plating with red detailing. In 34 ABY, the Abednedo laborer Roodown dragged a sled containing three non-functional I2-CG droids through Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku, passing the scavenger Rey as he did so. At some point Rey drew a picture of Roodown and the three droids in her survival guide.
